headline: Bitcoin held steady over Friday while US stocks fell, oil jumped and the 10-year Treasury yield rose to just under 5%; next week brings the Fed decision, US inflation data and Coinbase earnings.

market.asOf: Read about 23:56-23:59 UTC Fri 23 Oct (06:56-06:59 Bangkok Sat 24 Oct) from CoinGecko's coin pages. CoinMarketCap showed somewhat higher prices at the same time. BTC's and ETH's 24h changes could not be confirmed. Live prices are at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: 50, Neutral on alternative.me's Crypto Fear & Greed Index (68, Greed a day earlier); CoinMarketCap's own index reads 48 out of 100. Two different indices.

stories.title: Bitcoin holds steady as US stocks fall, oil spikes and the 10-year yield nears 5%
stories.summary: Bitcoin moved sideways all Friday while US stocks fell into the weekend and oil jumped to its highest settle since April. Expensive oil and higher bond yields make risky assets less attractive, so next week's Fed meeting is the next big test.
points: Bitcoin was $81,225.50 at 3:39pm ET Friday, down 0.22% over 24 hours, per CoinDesk's price page.
At Friday's close the S&P 500 fell 0.52% to 7,623.68, the Nasdaq 0.21% to 25,955.34 and the Dow 1.23% to 52,215.16, per Capp Notes' closing summary.
Brent crude rose 3.14% to settle at $116.72, its highest since 29 April, and WTI rose 3.80% to $103.27, per Capp Notes.
The 10-year Treasury yield rose 5 basis points to 4.999%, per Capp Notes.
About $431M of crypto positions were liquidated over 24 hours, per CoinGlass data cited by CryptoTicker.

stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs post their biggest one-day outflow since June, but the week is still positive
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs, funds that hold bitcoin for stock-market investors, saw $635.6 million leave on Thursday 22 Oct, more than wiping out Wednesday's inflow. Friday's figures had not been published when this edition was written.
points: Net outflow of $635.6M on Thursday, the largest daily outflow since June, per The Block.
Wednesday's inflow was $528.4M per The Block and $524.8M per Farside.
By fund on Thursday: BlackRock's IBIT -$254.1M, Fidelity's FBTC -$217.5M, ARK's ARKB -$109.4M, Grayscale's GBTC -$29.5M, Bitwise's BITB -$27.4M; Morgan Stanley's MSBT took in $2.3M, per Farside.
The week through Thursday is still about +$442.7M net, per The Block.
Spot ether ETFs lost $110.6M on Thursday, per The Block.

sources.label: The Block: Bitcoin ETFs swing back to net outflows

stories.title: Senator questions Tether's payments to a firm founded by ex-White House crypto adviser Bo Hines
stories.summary: Sen. Richard Blumenthal wrote to Tether, Bo Hines and Nxum, the consulting firm founded by Hines, asking for records of their dealings. Tether says it is reviewing the letter.
points: Blumenthal says the alleged payment, made while stablecoin legislation was being negotiated, "implicates federal ethics, anticorruption, and lobbying laws", per The Block.
The senator's letter refers to "Tether's alleged multimillion-dollar payment to a firm controlled by the White House official", per The Block.
Tether says it is reviewing the letter and that an earlier review by outside counsel "found no evidence of wrongdoing", per The Block.

briefs.title: More companies object to tokenized versions of their stock on OKX and ICE's platform
briefs.summary: Wells Fargo, Arm and Intuit are among the latest objectors; Reuters counts 22 of the 62 proposed stocks so far, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: IRS reportedly plans lower penalties for voluntary disclosures, crypto included
briefs.summary: Forbes reports a revamped program with "substantially lower" penalties and a 120-day target to resolve cases, launching before December 2026, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: SEC adds tokenized securities to its 2027 exam priorities
briefs.summary: Tokenized securities are flagged as a focus area, while crypto again has no standalone exam category, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: Initia halts its network after an exploit
briefs.summary: An attacker reportedly minted unbacked tokens and moved out about $2.6M-$2.73M; Initia has not confirmed the loss, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: Polymarket reportedly fired its marketing chief
briefs.summary: The New York Post, citing unnamed sources, says the CMO was let go after an internal probe; CoinDesk has not confirmed the report.

briefs.title: Ethereum delays a Glamsterdam upgrade test
briefs.summary: A testnet fork planned for 26 Oct was postponed after ChainSecurity flagged gas-related risks in EIP-8037 and EIP-8038, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: Phantom wallet brings Kalshi prediction markets to US users
briefs.summary: Trades are funded with Phantom's CASH stablecoin; some categories are blocked in Michigan, Nevada and Washington, per The Block.

briefs.title: Netanyahu asks for a blockchain plan in case of sanctions
briefs.summary: He said in a TV interview he wants a plan to help Israel's economy withstand possible sanctions, with no details on chain, currency or timing, per The Block.
